id: \bHello there.\nWould you like to hear about my Fearow?
en: \bHello there.\nWould you like to hear about my Fearow?
it: \bSalve.\nTi va di sentire del mio Fearow?

id: \bWell let's see... he is cute, smart, and all around just perfect.
en: \bWell let's see... he is cute, smart, and all around just perfect.
it: \bVediamo un po'... è carino, intelligente e, insomma, semplicemente perfetto.

id: \bThank you for listening to that. You can have this, its no trouble. I am a bit too old to be using it.
en: \bThank you for listening to that. You can have this, its no trouble. I am a bit too old to be using it.
it: \bGrazie di avermi ascoltato. Puoi prendere questo, nessun disturbo. Sono un po' troppo vecchio per usarlo.

id: \bDid you come to hear about my Pokémon again?
en: \bDid you come to hear about my Pokémon again?
it: \bSei venuto di nuovo a sentir parlare del mio Pokémon?

id: \rI just adore my Seel!\nIt's so lovable!
en: \rI just adore my Seel!\nIt's so lovable!

id: \rYou're a Trainer aren't you?\nCome see me when you beat the Gym Leader of this town.
en: \rYou're a Trainer aren't you?\nCome see me when you beat the Gym Leader of this town.
it: \rSei un Allenatore, vero?\nVieni a trovarmi quando avrai battuto il Capopalestra di questa città.

id: \rGood job on defeating him! Take this for your efforts.
en: \rGood job on defeating him! Take this for your efforts.
it: \rBel lavoro, l'hai sconfitto! Prendi questo per il tuo impegno.

id: \rA Light Ball raises the Attack and Special Attack of the Pikachu family.
en: \rA Light Ball raises the Attack and Special Attack of the Pikachu family.
it: \rL'Elettropalla aumenta l'Attacco e l'Attacco Speciale della famiglia di Pikachu.

id: \bMy Pikachu is twice as cute as that one.
en: \bMy Pikachu is twice as cute as that one.
it: \bIl mio Pikachu è carino il doppio di quello.
